landing.title: Tell us about your celebration. EVENTUS AI does the rest
landing.subtitle: Like ChatGPT, but for events. Wedding, toi, anniversary or corporate party — describe it by voice or text, and the assistant builds the plan and budget, finds available vendors, books them through a safe deal and sends invitations to your guests.
landing.point2: Only vendors free on your date
landing.howTitle: One conversation instead of a hundred calls
landing.how1: Tell us what you have in mind
landing.how1Text: One sentence or a voice note: date, city, guests, budget. The assistant sorts it out and asks only what's missing.
landing.how2Text: A checklist, a budget and vendors free on exactly your date — with prices, reviews and photos of their work.
landing.how3Text: The assistant books it, and the prepayment is frozen until both sides confirm the deal.
landing.storyHeroA: A toi to be proud of.
landing.story1p: Describe your celebration in one sentence. The assistant builds a plan within your budget, finds vendors who are free and keeps everything in one app — from the first call to the last guest.
landing.story2t: Twenty chats, three notebooks and no full picture
landing.story2p: The photographer on WhatsApp, the hall on Instagram, the host through an aunt. Prices in voice notes, agreements in chats, prepayments on trust. And the total grows faster than the to-do list.
landing.story3t: One sentence instead of a hundred calls
landing.story3p: Date, city, guests, budget — by voice or text. The assistant sorts it out and asks only what is missing.
landing.story4t: The amount first. Everything else after
landing.story4p: Say how much you are ready to spend — your own money, not what the neighbours expect. The assistant suggests how to split it and offers vendors who fit.
landing.story5t: Not “a friend of a friend”, a real choice
landing.story5p: Verified halls, hosts, photographers, motorcades and decor in Bishkek. Only those free on your date, with portfolios, reviews and ratings. Compare calmly, without pressure.
landing.story6t: All your vendors in one place
landing.story6p: Messages, details, dates and bookings live in one app, not in five messengers. If a vendor is busy, their AI assistant replies right away.
landing.story7p: You pay the prepayment through EVENTUS AI. We hold the money and release it to the vendor only when you both confirm. If something goes wrong, you get it back or our team settles the dispute.
landing.story8t: An exact guest count means no extra tables
landing.story8p: The invitation is a beautiful page with a personal link for every guest. Replies collect themselves: you see who is coming and don’t pay the hall for empty seats.
landing.story9t: Your toi is already on this screen
landing.story9p: Free for couples. Works in the browser and installs on your phone like an app. We are for beautiful celebrations — and for no debt after them.

faq: How is EVENTUS AI different from a catalog or Instagram?
In a catalog you search and call everyone yourself. In EVENTUS AI you just tell the assistant what you need, and it shows who's free on your date and fits your budget, then helps you book.
Can I just say it out loud?
Yes. Tap the mic and tell everything in your own words — date, place, guests, wishes. The assistant understands and asks only what's missing.
How much does EVENTUS AI cost for clients?
Nothing. The service is free for clients: you only pay vendors their prices.
What if a vendor doesn't show up?
The prepayment is frozen until the deal is confirmed. Open a dispute in the chat — the EVENTUS AI team reviews it and refunds you.
Yes. Until both sides confirm the deal, the prepayment is refunded in full.
How do I become a vendor?
Press “I'm a vendor” and tell us about yourself — your profile, first service and first post go live right away, and the assistant starts suggesting you to clients.
